items.title: Why O'Reilly (ORLY) Stock Is Trading Lower Today
items.summary: Shares of auto parts and accessories retailer O’Reilly Automotive (NASDAQ:ORLY) fell 2.7% in the afternoon session after competitor Advance Auto Parts posted disappointing second-quarter sales, raising concerns about demand across auto-parts retail. According to TipRanks, Advance Auto Parts plunged more than 20% on August 20, 2026 after revenue of $2 billion missed Wall Street’s estimate and comparable store sales fell 0.5%, with the adjusted EPS beat largely supported by tariff refunds. items.title: Consumer Stocks Are Big Losers After Latest Earnings Wave
items.summary: Consumer stocks were taking a beating after the latest round of retail earnings.  The consumer staples sector was the biggest laggard in the S&P 500 with a 1.9% decline.  Among the biggest S&P 500 losers of the day were Walmart, Ford Motor, Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings, lululemon athletica, and Auto Zone.
